description: This file defines the Deviations class, which contains static methods for statistical calculations such as deviations sum, kurtosis, and skewness, used within the PhpSpreadsheet library for spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: Deviations
classes.description: Provides static methods to calculate deviations, kurtosis, and skewness for data sets, used in spreadsheet statistical functions.

methods.name: sumSquares
methods.description: Calculates the sum of squared deviations from the mean for a set of data points.

methods.name: kurtosis
methods.description: Calculates the kurtosis (peakedness) of a data set.

methods.name: skew
methods.description: Calculates the skewness, indicating asymmetry, of a data set.
